senses.zh_definition: Preeti，南亚人名，常用作女性名字；是 Priti 的一种拉丁字母转写形式。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name used in several South Asian languages; a variant transcription of Priti.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan yang digunakan dalam beberapa bahasa Asia Selatan; variasi transliterasi nama Priti.
senses.nuances: 名称关系见 [Preeti](https://www.behindthename.com/name/preeti)。其词源含义不等于它在马来语中可以直接表示“爱”或“快乐”。输入没有 DBP 收录证据，故不标为官方马来语普通词条。马来文释义为编辑释义，排名仅沿用输入。

etymology.historical_story: Preeti is a Latin-script transcription associated with the name Priti in Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati. Priti derives from Sanskrit prīti, associated with pleasure, joy and love. This history explains the name's background, but does not make Preeti a Malay word meaning love. A person's own spelling remains decisive. See [Priti](https://www.behindthename.com/name/priti).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“Preeti 是姓名牌，prīti 是历史线索”来区分名字和词源；不要把 Preeti 当作马来语“爱”的替换词。
